Choose your friends wisely, and find the right groups.

Kevin Trudeau says association is one of the most critical things you can do if you want to succeed. Be very selective about who you spend time with.

He explains that in the right group you get more than energy. You support one another and pull for one another.

Who in your life pulls for you?

#ad #success #relationships #kevintrudeau

The past is where pain is. The future is where fear is.

Kevin Trudeau says most people spend their time in yesterday, last month, or a future they cannot know. What we actually have is today, and this moment.

He says that doing things with full awareness brings you into present time, where he finds nothing but bliss.

When did you last feel completely here?

#ad #mindset #happiness #kevintrudeau

Why the room you sit in can shape your confidence.

Kevin Trudeau says that spending time with 10 or 12 people with big personal presence soaks you in their imagination, decisiveness and confidence.

He calls the ritual simple: be in the physical space of other winners and like-minded people.

Who do you spend your time around right now?

#ad #success #confidence #kevintrudeau
